name: cart-chaos
description: CART CHAOS — party game 3D multijoueur dans le navigateur

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @cart-chaos/server" "npm run dev -w @cart-chaos/client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @cart-chaos/server && npm run build -w @cart-chaos/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
